what: v4.22: a 45-degree placement. A copy of ZZLL-1 (ZZLL-45) whose rows are all `MW` (one way: no rotation) with the 45-degree initial orientations as flip codes - FRONT 11 (rotate 45 CW), BACK 9 (45 CCW, flip X), COLLAR 10 (45 CCW), CUFF 12 (45 CW, flip X), SLEEVE 7 (90 CW) - made into a marker (Order Editor, LADIES-BLOUSE size 10 x 2), nested by AccuNest (Draft, no overrides), plotted by MarkPlot to ZZR-45.DXF.
result: every piece with a 45-degree code sits at a TILT of exactly +-45.0 degrees (slot byte +38, float32 radians) on top of its orientation code; the sleeve (90 degrees) has tilt 0. The decoded outline (mirror, turn, then tilt) lies on the plotted loop to 0.16 in (curve sag; cuff 0.001) on 14 slots; the collar needs its 90-degree stream frame (0.16 in with it, 7.1 in without) - a frame the stored home boxes cannot show when every slot is tilted 45 degrees (frames_ambiguous).
